decisions.reason: A classic lever handle line close to the core costs little to carry and fits the system breadth, and with no shortfall against aspiration in a growing market there is no trigger for problemistic search.
This single design has been absent from the website since 2018, so it is more exposed to range rationalization, but its carrying costs are low and slack lets the firm keep it.
